note: Development profile for bring-up gates G02-G07 on synthetic data. It fills paper-unspecified fields with versioned design decisions (DD-xx) and synthetic calibration values (SYN-xx). It is never deployable: SYN values must be replaced by the trained arm-(e) export (G04) and every DD must be confirmed against the model source.

overrides.bands.exponent_semantics: static per (level, band); band j int8 code = sat8(rshift_rne(acc_j, 23 - e_j)); low-pass uses e_low
overrides.descriptor_nu.definition: nu[l,j] = min(127, rshift_rne(div_rne(sum_{i in f at level l} sum_{c<48} z_j[i,c]^2, 48 * n_f_l), energy_shift)); 0 when n_f_l = 0

membership.level_extension.P3: own fragment id if the cell is a reserve anchor, else the P4 parent's id
membership.level_extension.P5: majority id of the 2x2 P4 children, ties to the smallest id; unassigned if no child is assigned

overrides.membership.class_band_weights: cell eligibility e (u8) at the level; uniform weights if the fragment's eligibility mass at that level is 0
overrides.membership.unassigned_readout: class band row = 0 (Pi row is zero), box band = N, fill rZ = 0
overrides.reserve.priority_rule: first pick argmax t; then argmax dmin2 * (256 + t)
overrides.reserve.distance: squared Euclidean distance on the P3 grid (integers)

linkage.work_model.check: at round start; a started round completes; exit when work >= budget and an eligible pair remains

overrides.gate.mask_layout: full square F_cap x F_cap bits, row-major, LSB-first within 32-bit words, row stride F_cap/32 words, symmetric, zero diagonal, rows and columns >= F are zero
overrides.posterior.duplicate_grouping: identity (each admissible source is its own unit)
overrides.trust.phi_presolve_source: per-source moment rows phi_g (4 x Q8.39) delivered with H3 head outputs; the producer must be confirmed against the model (roadmap 2.2)
overrides.forecast.abstention_event: C_f empty, or the null weight w_0 >= sum of admissible weights (counted, never changes a value)

dispatcher_abi.framing: every response is header (8 words) + out_words payload (even) + trailer (4 words); counters follow the payload because a worker streams its outputs as it computes them; the trailer check chains from the header check
dispatcher_abi.check_rule: c = 0x9E3779B9; for w in words[0:n-1]: c = rotl32(c, 5) ^ w; the result is stored in the last word

field_formats.evidence: Q7.8, first n_partners admissible partners in ascending id order
field_formats.xy: x | y << 8 on the P4 lattice
field_formats.reserve_scores: 5x5 window of the P4 parent, index (dy+2)*5 + (dx+2)
field_formats.P.scores: forward half-window, 12 offsets per P4 cell in LINK_FWD order
field_formats.cand: 4 words: level<<16|cell, class<<16|score_q15, box01 (2 x i16), box23 (2 x i16)

formats.transport.saturation.why: makes |dH| <= 127 so the stated |r| <= 127 + B = 191 LSB holds (roadmap 2.2)

walk.affinity_frac.why: w in Q0.15; lateral tap = div_rne(w << 13, 2^15 + sum w) is exact integer export of P = I/2 + S^-1(I+W)/2

modulation.w_frac.why: same affinity codes as the walk export

bands.beta_frac.why: beta in Q0.16; powers by repeated RNE products give monotone cumulative sums

bands.exponents.why: per-band exponents must be calibrated on the trained model (roadmap 7.3)

bands.exponent_semantics.why: static exponents keep the band format fixed per layer

descriptor_nu.energy_shift.why: nu as int8 log-free energy code; replace by the model's descriptor definition

membership.level_extension.why: must match the trained model's export

membership.class_band_weights.why: R needs nonzero weights at every level; anchors exist only at P3/P4

membership.unassigned_readout.why: follows Pi = M R with zero rows for unassigned cells (roadmap 2.2, Lemma 3 note)

reserve.priority_rule.why: thin-aware farthest-point sampling with deterministic ties

linkage.score_format.why: u8 scores q/255; theta_T and the guard compared by integer cross-products

linkage.work_model.why: logical work charge shared by reference and PL; independent of FIFOs and clocks (roadmap 8.6)

linkage.neighbour_list_cap.why: bounded cluster lists; overflow is a counted protocol error, never a silent truncation

gate.prec_frac.why: precision codes p = 2^8 / sigma^2 in mu-code units; tau is stored as tau * 2^8

gate.thresholds.why: 13.3 is the value displayed in Fig. 2(i); calibrated thresholds come from the model

bf24.add_guard_bits.why: addition is exact RNE: exponent differences below 24 + guard (= 26) are aligned exactly in 64 bits and normalized once; larger differences return the larger operand, which is the RNE result

bf24.recip_seed_table.why: 12-bit seed + two Newton steps as drawn in Fig. 3(d)

posterior.evidence_format.why: pair evidence s in Q7.8; w = e^s via a two-level 2^f table with relative error below 2^-20

posterior.duplicate_grouping.why: identity grouping until the model's duplicate rule is imported; E_dup = 0

trust.phi_presolve_source.why: interface decision; resolves the dependency audit of roadmap 2.2 only once the model confirms the producer

forecast.logit_format.why: Q?.4 logits clamped to [-8, 8): the table exponential needs no row maximum, so column blocks add exactly

forecast.exp_table.why: uint32 weights; numerator and denominator sums fit int64

forecast.logit_multipliers.why: logit scales come from the trained maps K, U, u0, u_alpha

forecast.abstention_event.why: operational definition of the counted abstention (roadmap 2.2)

readout.rz_shift.why: scale of the r Z product comes from the model

boundary.packet_layouts.why: generated byte-exact layouts; figure KB are labels only (roadmap 2.3)
